title: Foster the bass player and his brother Dude
summary: Foster is no relation to Pops Foster; he is Foster Lewis, Dude's brother, who played bass then trombone, even in church before he died.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: I was going to ask her about the bass player there. Foster. Was he any relation to George? The one they called Pops Foster?
That's different. Or Willie Foster. You know the guitar player and violin. I know. I know. I know him.
What about Foster the trombone player? You know Dude's brother?

That man used to play trombone. That's a Foster. That's Dude's brother? That's Dude's brother. That's right. That's Foster Lewis. First time. First time Lewis. Yeah. He used to play trombone. Then he fall back home. At least that was his first instrument. That bass. Then he started playing trombone. He died. He was playing trombone in church. Just before he died. Oh yeah?
